title: The Big Noise from Winnetka
studio_context: The quartet live at the London House, Chicago; Bob Haggart and Ray Bauduc's bass-and-drums piece.

drum_performances.name: Gene Krupa
drum_performances.why_it_matters: Two snare figures, a ruff-led syncopation and quarter notes on the beat, juggled across the bar line over the bass drum's four.

drums.description: Two snare figures juggled across the bar line in metric shifts over four on the bass drum.
